explication: DeepSeek Harness Mobile is a native Android/iOS client for remote Harness workspaces and agent sessions. Users pair a device with a Mobile Gateway, browse workspaces and sessions, then send messages and follow streamed replies, tool activity, history, and trajectories; they can also respond to questions or approvals and manage remote files. The platforms share protocol, state, projection, synchronization, and file-state logic, while each owns its UI and system integrations. README documents both platforms’ broader capabilities; the sampled source is partial, so uncertain internal wiring is omitted.
